title: Fenrir Avali
description: Pack that replaces Chickens and Sword with beautiful alternatives!
body:
This Resource Pack change the texture of vanilla chickens into a Fenrir Avali!

![Fenrir Avali](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/566a4cc89694c78965903b9232e33cc584f00589.png)

Ralsei's wonderful sword will also be added instead Iron Sword!

![Ralsei Sword Demonstration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ec771d38a2b4b62c20e57e6b7def338c16f91e2.png)
